articles.summary: BLACKSBURG, VA., April 23, 2026 - National Bankshares, Inc. (the Company) (Nasdaq: NKSH), parent company of The National Bank of Blacksburg (the Bank) and National Bankshares Financial Services, Inc., today announced its results of operations through the first quarter of 2026.
